description: Deliverable 3: per-town map data with a GREEN/GREY/RED traffic-light class, plus the frontend contract doc. Because no verified per-town consumption source exists (docs/apis/06; map.md 'never color by a number we don't have'), the per-town level is an explicit statewide RECS model flagged modeled:true; the traffic-light classifies weighted terciles of the RECS MA annual-kWh distribution (GREEN <= P33, GREY <= P66, RED > P66). Builds data/build/map_consumption.json (351 town records, join-ready on town id) and writes research/backend-stats.md documenting all three artifact shapes. Depends on FEAT-001's loaders and weighted_percentile; references FEAT-002's savings shape in the doc.
steps: Create src/backend/map_consumption.py: compute greenMax = weighted_percentile(RECS annual kWh, NWEIGHT, 0.33) and greyMax = ...0.66; classify(kwh) -> GREEN/GREY/RED by those cuts; build one record per town. If data/build/towns.json exists, read id/name/census from it; otherwise emit townId 1..351 with name/census null and record the fallback in findings. Flag basis='statewide-model', modeled=true, and include the note from the plan.

Create src/backend/build_map.py entrypoint writing data/build/map_consumption.json per the plan shape (generated, basis, modeled, note, thresholds{unit, greenMax, greyMax, rule}, towns[{townId,name,census,annualKwhModel,class}]). Print a one-line summary.

Create tests/backend/test_map.py covering tests 7-8 from the plan: greenMax == weighted P33 and greyMax == weighted P66; boundary classification at exactly P33 and P66; exactly 351 records each with class in {GREEN,GREY,RED}; modeled is true; every annualKwhModel finite and > 0; JSON round-trips with required keys.

Write research/backend-stats.md: document the three JSON shapes (consumption_stats.json, savings_model.json, map_consumption.json) exactly as emitted, the savings SIGN convention (+ = saved vs basic service), the traffic-light tercile rule and the actual greenMax/greyMax values, and the modeled-town honesty caveat. If a later G-OWN check flags research/ ownership, note it in findings and relocate the doc under docs/research/backend-stats.md.
acceptance_criteria: Running `python3 src/backend/build_map.py` creates/overwrites data/build/map_consumption.json with no error.

map_consumption.json has exactly 351 town records; each class is one of GREEN/GREY/RED; thresholds.greenMax == weighted P33 and thresholds.greyMax == weighted P66 of the RECS MA annual-kWh distribution; modeled == true.
research/backend-stats.md documents all three artifact shapes, the savings sign convention, and the traffic-light rule, matching the emitted JSON key-for-key.
Running `python3 -m pytest tests/backend/test_map.py -q` passes all tests.
findings:
DONE. New files: src/backend/map_consumption.py, src/backend/build_map.py, tests/backend/test_map.py, research/backend-stats.md. Regenerated data/build/map_consumption.json.

Threshold values (weighted terciles of RECS MA annual kWh, NWEIGHT-weighted, via data_sources.weighted_percentile): greenMax (P33) = 4814.67, greyMax (P66) = 7966.61. Modeled per-town level = statewide weighted P50 = 5990.09 kWh (same value every town, flagged modeled:true / basis:'statewide-model'). At that level all 351 towns classify GREY. Boundary rule: <=P33 GREEN, <=P66 GREY, >P66 RED (upper-inclusive).

TOWNS FALLBACK ACTIVE: data/build/towns.json does not exist in the sandbox (needs network download the Monte-Carlo/city workflow owns), so map_consumption.json emits townId 1..351 with name/census = null, join-ready on 'id'. If a later step builds towns.json, re-run `python3 src/backend/build_map.py` to pick up real id/name/census.

G-OWN RISK (not relocated): structure.md's ownership table maps research/*.md to specific owners by exact filename; research/backend-stats.md is NOT in the table (closest entries: research/stats.md=stats-engine, research/towns.md=city-model). Followed the plan and wrote it at research/backend-stats.md as a new backend-only filename. If the G-OWN gate flags it, relocate to docs/research/backend-stats.md (plan step 4 / open-risk) — content is unaffected.

VERIFICATION (all pass): `python3 src/backend/build_map.py` writes 351 towns with a one-line summary; `python3 -m pytest tests/backend/test_map.py -q` = 6 passed; `python3 -m pytest tests/backend -q` = 32 passed; untouched snapshot gate `python3 reference/verify_usage.py data/snapshot/recs_ma_2020.csv data/snapshot/eia_ma_monthly_2026-08.csv` still prints G-DATA-3: PASS.

research/backend-stats.md documents all three artifact shapes (consumption_stats.json, savings_model.json, map_consumption.json) key-for-key against the emitted JSON, the savings sign convention (+ = saved vs basic service), and the traffic-light tercile rule with the actual greenMax/greyMax.
